import ast, io, subprocess, tokenize
from pathlib import Path
BASE="7840899ea7ac0609bf3e0dec5e26effdbda1ec6c"
PATHS=["src/rebar/_store/push_state.py","src/rebar/_store/push.py","src/rebar/_store/s3_doctor.py","src/rebar/_store/staging.py","src/rebar/_store/stamped_lock.py","src/rebar/_store/store_usability.py","src/rebar/_store/sync.py","src/rebar/_mcp_serving.py","src/rebar/_mcp_writes.py","src/rebar/_mcp_derive.py","src/rebar/_opcert_signing.py","src/rebar/_opcert_verify.py","src/rebar/_operation_config.py","src/rebar/_proc.py","src/rebar/config.py","src/rebar/mcp_server.py","src/rebar/mirror_guard.py","src/rebar/secret_screen.py","src/rebar/signing.py"]
def normalized(src):
 tree=ast.parse(src,type_comments=True)
 for node in ast.walk(tree):
  if isinstance(node,ast.TypeIgnore): node.lineno=0
  body=getattr(node,'body',None)
  if isinstance(body,list) and body and isinstance(body[0],ast.Expr) and isinstance(body[0].value,ast.Constant) and isinstance(body[0].value.value,str): body[0].value.value='DOCSTRING'
 return ast.dump(tree,include_attributes=False)
def directives(src):
 out=[]
 for tok in tokenize.generate_tokens(io.StringIO(src).readline):
  if tok.type==tokenize.COMMENT and any(s in tok.string for s in ('noqa','type:','pyright:','mypy:','ruff:','fmt:','isort:','pragma:','nosec','coverage:','mechanism-ok:','raw-git-ok:','tickets-boundary-ok:','read-via:','repo-root-ok:')): out.append(tok.string)
 return out
for path in PATHS:
 before=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',BASE+':'+path],text=True)
 final=Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
 assert normalized(before)==normalized(final),('AST/runtime drift',path)
 assert directives(before)==directives(final),('directive drift',path)
print('prose-only AST and directive oracle passed for',len(PATHS),'files')
PY
